_readme: Hand-curated UI texts that win over machine translation.
Shape: { module: { language folder: { key: text } } }.
A key is either a resource symbol from the module's .rh files (preferred,
e.g. IDT_HOSTADDRESS) or '#' followed by the exact English text.
Use this for what context cannot fix: grammatical gender of a lone button
label, a domain term the engine renders literally, or two different
English words that must not collapse into one word in the target language.
Applied by tools/translate/merge.py (load_overrides) and reported as
'human' in the coverage table. Accelerators (&) must stay unique within a

_feature_071: Command Shell page: the page name follows each language's existing term
for the Command Shell command (menu IDS_MENU_CMD_SHELL), the corpus is
formal (Sie/vous/usted/u), \n carries no padding spaces, and the
product name 'Windows Terminal' stays as Microsoft names it.

_feature_078: Panel tabs (feature 078): the term for a tab follows each language's platform
convention (cs/sk karta, de Registerkarte, fr onglet, es pestana, nl tabblad,
ro fila, hu lap); shortcut labels inside the strings keep the English
Ctrl+Shift form the menu rows use; the close confirmation keeps a single %d.
_feature_079: Crash closing message (feature 079): DeepL returned the informal register
(du/tu/je/tu) for the long message in de/fr/nl/es while the corpus is formal;
the four pins keep Sie/vous/u/usted, the %s placeholder and the GitHub URL.
_feature_084: Archiver not found (feature 084): DeepL returned the informal register (du/tu/tu) for the
long message in de/fr/es and invented its own names for the configuration page and the
menu command it refers to; the pins keep the formal register, the %1 placeholder and the
exact UI names each language already shows (dialog 2340 caption, IDS_MENU_OPT_ARCHAUTOCFG,
IDS_MENU_OPT). German also keeps the corpus term 'Packprogramm' in the other three new messages.
Final review (084): the other new messages follow each corpus' own word for an archiver
(es compresor, nl archiveringsprogramma, hu archiváló, sk archivačný program), French uses
the corpus' straight apostrophe and one wording for both console-program names.
_feature_101: Move-check messages (feature 101): DeepL returned the informal register (du/tu/je/tu) for
the two long messages in de/fr/nl/es while the corpus is formal; the pins keep Sie/vous/u/
usted and reuse each corpus' own words from the neighbouring link message (14181) and the
Pack dialog's 'delete files from disk after packing' check box (de Verknüpfungen, vom
Datenträger; es ficheros; cs označení, po přidání do archivu; hu mappa - DeepL wrote könyvtár).
Slovak: DeepL wrote the Czech word 'vnořený' (sk vnorený). French uses the corpus' straight
apostrophe and « %s » as in the 084 pins. Romanian kept as DeepL wrote it (formal, as the
071/084 pins); the short IDS_DIRNESTEDTOODEEP kept in cs/de/nl/ro/es.
_feature_123: New version check (feature 123). Czech is pinned whole: the menu command's name is fixed by
the specification (FR-028, 'Zkontrolovat novou verzi') and the maintainer's language should not
depend on the engine's wording. German, French, Dutch and Spanish: DeepL returned the informal
register (du/tu/je/tu) for the long messages and the hint - pinned formal (Sie/vous/u/usted).
'Released %s' lost its space or was turned round in six languages ('Veroeffentlicht%s',
'%s a ete publiee', ...) - pinned with the date last; '(checked %s)' likewise. Slovak: wording
aligned with the Czech pins. Dutch: the configuration option was too long for its control
(found by both independent reviews) - shortened. Romanian: one register (formal) in the window
and one caption for the command's wait dialog and answers. Accelerators on the General page
moved off letters already used there (cs n, sk m, ro l, es d).
